_comment: Segmentation settings. Revised independently of the workflow; scripts/tsegment.py reads this file and command-line flags override it. The prose policy is in segmentation.md.
_scan_edge: Longest edge, in pixels, of the pass-1 copies. Large enough to see a change of hand, a signature block or a blank verso. Untested below this.
_window: Photos per pass-1 window, for dossiers too large to inspect in one pass.
_overlap: Photos shared between consecutive windows, so a document straddling a boundary is still seen whole.
_review_tag: Applied to every item the workflow creates, on top of the tags inherited from the dossier.
